answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy can require a lantern trail: every newcomer must cross a ridge of small, public, time-separated tasks, each checked by strangers with no shared sponsor. Only verified work lights the next lantern, and the trail grows harder with each step, so running many fake identities means paying the full climb for each one. At the summit, independent peers review the whole trail before granting full standing. A copied trail, reused lantern, or forged checkpoint extinguishes that identity and bars its sponsor from lighting new lanterns.
